# T2.10: M2 wrap-up

- The experimental `encode1` (all `NVENC_VAR` knobs the T2.0x reports use) is committed as d56225c for reference.
- `tools/encode1.c` rewritten with the working settings as defaults and no experiment knobs. It keeps
  `NVENC_REPLAY` / `NVENC_DUMPSETUP` (comparing against captured setups will be needed again for P-frames) and the
  MMU-fault buffer map. Defaults: input in `nvenc_in_tile_plane` layout (block_height 2) + 64 KB slack; recon
  block-linear block_height 2, 32-row planes; one method per plane, surface offsets 0; `slice_mode` 0; intra SSD counts
  1; history sized with `H264_HIST_BLOCK_SIZE`; only the buffers H.264 IDR needs (no RC buffers, no scratch).
- Same results as T2.09 at all five sizes (256x128 45.25 dB … 3840x2160 45.84 dB luma).
- `design.md`: M2 marked done, "M2 notes" section. `README.md`: status, layout, an encode example.
